meta.description: Transcribed post-competition feedback from Disease Detectives events (Cobb County Regional 2011-2024, State of Georgia 2019/2022/2024)
meta.purpose: Source of truth for exam topic coverage, used to build Sigma Sleuth mock test questions

regional_cobb.format: Primarily multiple choice + matching/word bank. Some years include 2x2 tables, calculation questions, reading comprehension scenarios.

state_georgia.question_count: 60 multiple choice + 16 short answer (3 pts each)
state_georgia.format: Paper test with separate question packet and answer sheet. More complex scenarios, odds ratio, chronic disease, graph interpretation.
